summary.text: Robert People, a Democratic candidate and retired U.S. Army veteran, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Florida's 15th Congressional District to Laurel Lee.
He served in the Army from 1997 to 2018 and described himself as running to continue public service.

paragraphs.text: People was born in Baltimore, Maryland, graduated from Parkville High School, and attended the University of Maryland Global Campus.
He served in the U.S. Army from 1997 to 2018, which he describes as 21 years of service, and lists his career experience as a writer.
He said he was 46 years old and was running because he wanted to continue public service rather than remain on the sidelines.
During the campaign, he said he was running on protecting Social Security, women's reproductive and health rights, and raising teacher pay.
He received 45.7% of the vote to Laurel Lee's 54.3%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
